summary: Strong adherence to PowerShell conventions (Set-StrictMode, -ErrorActionPreference, parameter validation, -LiteralPath). Workflow correctly uses least-privilege permissions, pinned actions, and shell: pwsh. Main gaps: (1) Get-LicenseConfig lacks validation of JSON structure (allow/deny arrays)—silently fails if malformed; (2) ConvertTo-CleanVersion missing [CmdletBinding()]; (3) workflow defaults to fixtures/package.json without existence check; (4) unused -FailOnViolation parameter in Invoke-LicenseCheck.ps1. Functions are small and testable; module/CLI separation is clean. Workflow should run in act but depends on fixture/config files existing.
